serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
What?! I can’t access the website? Was I banned?!
So that mysterious caller really was the Admin, huh…
Who else would have enough power to ban me beside him?
Fuck, seems like my decision was wrong in the end and I didn’t learn any new things about them.
At least it’s all over and my safety should be secured, right? There’s nothing to gain for them from going after me.
I’m kinda disappointed, but also relieved.
Now I have more time for other things which might be a good thing actually.
